about_tanmeyah_des: Tanmeyah for microenterprise services is the largest non-bank financing company specialized in serving microenterprises in the Egyptian market, and ranks second among the financiers of that pivotal segment of projects nationwide. The company is unique in its ability to support and serve the financing needs of owners of small and micro projects, especially societal groups that are not covered by the traditional banking sector. In providing its distinguished services, the company relies on the latest technology, in addition to a highly qualified and experienced team that works to support and serve the financing needs of micro-enterprise owners in areas most in need of such services.
